project.title: WhyStrohm. How The System Actually Works

series_lock.character: founder, mid-thirties, salt-and-pepper hair, navy crewneck, speaking directly to camera, calm authoritative posture
series_lock.environment: minimalist home office, white walls, oak desk, single houseplant, late afternoon
series_lock.lighting: soft natural side-light, large window camera-left, warm afternoon golden hour, gentle shadow rolloff
series_lock.color_grade: warm filmic, muted teal shadows, slight grain, cream highlights, deep navy shadows never crushed

shots.subject: founder, looking directly into camera, slight knowing smile, mid-statement
shots.vo: Most founders treat content like a hobby.
shots.rationale: Hook is provocative but calm, voice carries the bite. Direct eye contact, MCU lock-in.

shots.subject: founder, gesturing slightly with one hand, explaining, eye contact maintained
shots.vo: Then they wonder why every post feels like starting over. New idea, new angle, no compounding.
shots.rationale: Stakes beat. Pulled out to MS to let the gesture read. VO does the work, no on-screen text needed.

shots.subject: close on founder's eyes, considered expression, slight head tilt
shots.vo: It's not creativity. It's missing infrastructure.
shots.rationale: ECU pulls the audience into the realization moment. Text reinforces the line that needs to land.

shots.subject: founder, leaning slightly forward, more energy in delivery, hands resting on desk
shots.vo: Every brand has a voice. Most founders never extract it. So every post starts from scratch.
shots.rationale: Insight beat, slow push as the thesis builds. VO is the load-bearing element here.

shots.subject: founder gestures toward laptop screen, kanban-style content pipeline visible, voice extraction interface, brand-lock file open in editor
shots.vo: Extract it once. Lock it in code. Now every post compounds.
shots.rationale: Show the artifact. Text reinforces the three-step pattern. Deep DOF keeps the screen legible.

shots.subject: founder, calm steady delivery, eye contact, hands folded
shots.vo: 11 brands. 800 videos rendered from code. 48-hour content cycles. One operator.
shots.rationale: Proof beat, concrete numbers. Stat callout in upper-third lets viewer absorb visually while VO confirms.

shots.subject: founder, slight smile, settled into the explanation, room visible around him
shots.vo: Not because we work harder. Because the system runs.
shots.rationale: Slow pull releases tension. The thesis lands. VO carries, text would dilute.

shots.subject: founder, calm, looks directly into camera one more time, almost-smile, settled
shots.vo: If this sounds like the version of content you actually want, run a free scan.
shots.rationale: CTA beat. Static MCU brings it home. URL holds in lower-third for full read-twice duration.
